_comment: Best-effort real-world magnitude anchors for common/recurring drug generalization tiers, used by src/cloak/lattice_producer/coherence.py to keep per-level counts internally consistent across a run. Not certifying counts (the deterministic compiler in reference_sources.py handles those); this is a fallback anchor for tiers that recur across many entries where the raw per-entry corpus median has no real signal to separate genuinely different categories. Promoted from scripts/spikes/clean_drug_health_lattice_coherence.py.

_sources.medication: FDA Orange Book: ~11,000+ approved drug products (OTC+Rx combined)
_sources.prescription medication: FDA Orange Book: ~1,300-1,500 unique approved active ingredients
_sources.therapeutic agent: order-of-magnitude estimate between medication and pharmaceutical compound tiers
_sources.other entries: rough counts of distinct approved members of that pharmacologic class, from general pharmacology/clinical knowledge, not a specific registry lookup
